LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_EnterFullScreenTip: Full screen: make the window as tall as the screen
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_FullScreenTip: Makes the research window as tall as the screen. The button in the window's title bar toggles this too.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_ShowTabCountsTip: Shows completed/total project counts next to each tab's name. Every tab's tooltip always shows project and research point totals, regardless of this setting.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_SuppressEmergenceLine: Hides prerequisite lines into or out of Node Research's emergence nodes unless one end is selected. Turn off to always show those lines.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_CombineAllTabsTip: Puts every technology except Anomaly, Gravship and Save Our Ship 2 on the Main tab, laid out in one block per tech level from left to right.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_CombineIndustrialTip: Merges High and Late Industrial technologies back into the main Industrial tab.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_CombineIndustrialIncl: Included in Combine All Tabs. Turn that off to choose this separately.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_SeparateErasTip: Leaves a narrow gap between one tech level's block and the next on the combined tab. Off, the blocks sit side by side, as in the vanilla tree.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_CrossEraLinesTip: Draws prerequisite lines between projects of different tech levels on the combined tab, as vanilla does. Turn off to hide them and cut the clutter.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_ColorCardsTip: Tints each project card with its tech level's color. Turn off for plain gray cards.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_ColorsOnCoreTip: Each era's color is picked on UI Rethemed - Core's settings page.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_MinorAnchorTip: A project with this many direct follow-ups on its own tab is treated as a hub: it keeps its place in the tree when a column is full, and the lesser projects move aside instead.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_MajorAnchorTip: A major hub is never grouped with another hub. With no prerequisite on its tab it starts after everything before it; otherwise it sits as soon after its prerequisites as there is room.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_WriteLayoutLogTip: Writes every project's column, row and hub type, and each hub's placement decisions, to Player.log whenever the layout is built.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_FilterLockedTip: Shows projects that can't be started yet: missing a prerequisite, techprint, research bench or other requirement. Click to show or hide them.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_FilterFinishedTip: Shows projects you have already researched. Click to show or hide them.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_FilterFutureTip: Shows unfinished projects above your colony's tech level. Your tech level comes from your starting faction, and rises as Node Research's emergence projects are completed. Click to show or hide them.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_FitTip: Fit the whole tab in view
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_ZoomInTip: Zoom in (or use the mouse wheel)
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_ZoomOutTip: Zoom out (or use the mouse wheel)
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_OpenOnCurrentTip: Brings the project being researched into view every time the window opens. When off, each tab stays where you left it.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_CurvedLinesTip: Draws the lines between projects as smooth curves. When off, they are straight.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_HighlightChainTip: Lights up every project the selected one needs, all the way back, not only its direct prerequisites.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_CardUnlockIconsTip: Shows up to three icons on each card for the buildings and items it unlocks.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_CardChipsTip: Shows techprints applied and things studied on cards that need them, in red until the requirement is met.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_CardProgressStripTip: Shows a thin progress bar along the bottom of cards that have progress.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_HoverFoundation: Foundation: counts towards advancing to the next era.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_QueueEmpty: Shift-click a project to queue it, along with any prerequisites it still needs. When the current project finishes, the first queued project that can start is researched next.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_QueueOffResearchQueue: Research Queue chooses what to research, so this queue is off. Use Research Queue's window instead.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_QueueOffSemiRandom: Semi Random Research's Prohibit normal project selection setting is on, so it chooses what to research and this queue is off. Turn that setting off to use the queue.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_QueueClearTip: Removes every project from the queue. The current project keeps going.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_QueueRowTip: Click to show it in the tree. Drag to change its place in the queue.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_EnqueueTip: Adds the project to the end of the queue, after any prerequisites it still needs, or takes it out again. Shift-click a card to do the same.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_EraBandsTip: On tabs laid out era by era, tints each era's columns and shows its name along the top.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_ShowTimeLeftTip: Shows roughly how long each project takes to research, on its card, hover card and details, how long the current project has left, and when each queued project should be done. Times use the colony's research pace over the last day, are saved with the game, and appear after an hour of research.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_HoverTime: Time: about {0} at the colony's recent research pace
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_HoverTimeUnknown: Time: shown once the colony has done an hour of research
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_CardSizeTip: Compact cards show the project's name only and fit more on screen; Large cards have room for bigger icons.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_ColumnSpacingTip: The gap between columns of cards in the research window, as a share of the usual gap. Lower fits more on screen; higher leaves more room for lines.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_RowSpacingTip: The gap between cards stacked in a column, as a share of the usual gap.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_MaxPerColumnTip: The most projects stacked in one column before the layout starts another. Fewer makes a wider, shorter tree; more makes a taller, narrower one. The tree is laid out again when you close the settings.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized2_CardHoverCardTip: Shows a card with the project's description, cost, prerequisites and what it unlocks without further research when you hover over it.
